nodes.summary: A real-valued process $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ on $\Omega$, indexed by $t \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$, is adapted to a filtration $(\mathcal{F}_t)_{t \ge 0}$ when $B_t$ is $\mathcal{F}_t$-measurable for every $t \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Adapted real process

nodes.summary: Let $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ be a real-valued process on $\Omega$ and let $s \ge 0$. The centered cylinders at time $s$ are the events $\bigcap_{t \in S} \{\omega \in \Omega : B_{s+t}(\omega) - B_s(\omega) \in C_t\}$, where $S \subset \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ is a finite set and each $C_t \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ is a Borel set.
nodes.title: Cylinder events of the centered shifted path

nodes.summary: Let $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ be a real-valued process on $\Omega$, let $s \ge 0$, and let $S \subset \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ be a finite set. For $u \ge 0$ let $u^-$ be the largest element of $S$ strictly below $u$, or $0$ if there is none. Then for every $t \in S$ and every $\omega \in \Omega$, $B_{s+t}(\omega) - B_s(\omega) = \sum_{u \in S : u \le t} (B_{s+u}(\omega) - B_{s+u^-}(\omega))$.
nodes.title: Telescoping the centered shifted path over a finite set

nodes.summary: Let $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ be a real-valued process on a measure space $(\Omega, \mu)$ and let $s \ge 0$. This is the pushforward of $\mu$ under the map sending $\omega \in \Omega$ to the path $t \mapsto B_{s+t}(\omega) - B_s(\omega)$, a measure on the space of functions $\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0} \to \mathbb{R}$ with its product σ-algebra.
nodes.title: Law of the centered shifted path

nodes.summary: Let $(B_t)_{t \ge 0}$ be a real-valued process on $\Omega$ and let $s \ge 0$. The centered shifted path at time $s$ sends $\omega \in \Omega$ to the function $t \mapsto B_{s+t}(\omega) - B_s(\omega)$ on $\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$.
